data.revised_prompt:
Round 1 visual exploration: clear symbolic stage concept, simple readable silhouettes, establish the three-color system, not overdesigned yet.

Asset ID: detail_archaeology_costume
Asset type: detail
Primary request: Costume detail sheet: archaeology utility vest fabric, gloves, knee pads, tool belt, brush pocket, measuring tape, dust marks, earth-brown canvas, bronze-green stitching accent, practical stage costume close-ups
Prompt pattern: Prop and costume detail sheet for art department, close-up material study with 3-4 arranged views, matte neutral background, clear scale, texture and wear marks, no labels or readable text.
Research anchors: Sanxingdui bronze/gold/earth for archaeology; West China Hospital plateau medical rescue gear for medical lane; GRID student satellite and lab-blue cube for technology lane.
Style: high-end Chinese recital drama stage concept design, symbolic but practical for theater production, photorealistic concept art with designerly restraint.
Lighting: visible theatrical beams, controlled haze, black-box stage depth, area color washes, practical glowing props.
Composition: professional art department board, elegant negative space, clear silhouette, no text overlays.
Quality: detailed fabric weave, worn material texture, realistic contact shadows, coherent palette, no plastic skin, no airbrushing, no digital oversharpening.
Negative prompt: no readable text, no watermark, no extra fingers, no deformed hands, no broken limbs, no duplicate faces, no Japanese kimono, no samurai, no shrine, no sci-fi armor, no astronauts, no fake logos, no cluttered chaos, no sterile showroom, no cartoon.
